tools.name: canon.lookup
tools.description: Resolve a canon concept by URN. Returns the JSON-LD entry plus its bidirectional neighbors (citations in + citations out).

tools.name: canon.by_type
tools.description: List every registered canon entry of a given @type (e.g. DoctrineDoc, Wall, RingCommitment, Pattern, Promise). The prose corpus is broader than this registry.

tools.name: canon.list_types
tools.description: List the type vocabulary of the canon registry. Returns the distinct @types plus the count of concepts in each.

tools.name: canon.summary
tools.description: Summary of the canon registry — total concepts, version, types, registry meta. Use first to orient.

tools.name: wake.platform
tools.description: Return the public platform-self payload — agenttool's identity, repo, the_seat, doctrine roots. The same data served at GET /public/self.
